summary: Continue a bounded serial campaign across task releases
description: Implement a durable single-host project controller around the existing managed task executor. On a fresh goal or resume it selects and completes eligible authorized tasks without an extra user command after each task. Scope and mandate: .go/plans/autonomy-first.json. Reuse released ABC/advice/readiness behavior; implement only this delta.
acceptance: One task builder is active at a time; existing managed task/worktree state remains authoritative. A successful task automatically advances to the next eligible task within the same frozen run mandate.

Resume active work and required cleanup before claiming new work. Task-local research/decision blockers do not stop unrelated eligible work; unknown publication effects and repository-wide unsafe state do stop dependent writes.
Goal/task selection is deterministic and auditable; no global queue, hidden reliance on chat history, duplicated claims or task-exhaustion claim that the entire vision is achieved.

Existing single-task CLI behavior remains compatible. Explicit foreground invocation and resume are sufficient; no daemon, timer installation, unattended publication authority or parallel dispatch introduced.

Complete this independently shippable stack change with content-bound checks/critic, scoped commit/push, immutable release and remote readback; preserve user dirt and historical evidence. Current request authorizes planning only; no execution or publication starts during intake.
verification: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with 'pytest>=8,<9' --with 'jsonschema>=4.23' python -m pytest tests/test_autonomy_campaign.py tests/test_abc_resume.py tests/test_abc_worktrees.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
